title: Cyber Verification Program | Claude Help Center
summary: Individual applicants can seek Defense Access on a paid plan; the other tiers are intended for organizations.
Applicants provide identity and security-work information and attest to applicable controls through the official portal.
Common secure-development tasks remain available outside CVP. A proposed exploit-validation workflow alone is not proof of blocked work.
Using a CVP grant for a customer-facing product or service requires separate approval.
